findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy

body.summary:
https://example.com — HTTP 200, TLS valid, 2 medium, 2 low, 2 info.
[medium] No HSTS — Responses are downgradable to plain HTTP on the first hit.
[medium] No Content-Security-Policy — An injected script has no policy to stop it.
[low] No framing protection — Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors is set.
[low] No X-Content-Type-Options — Browsers may sniff a response into a different content type.
[info] No Referrer-Policy — Full URLs, including query strings, leak to third parties.
